obstacle: Locked biscuit door. The key can be found in another room. Smashing it takes time and makes noise.
Steep wall of slick icing. Without spikes or rope, climbers risk exhaustion or falling.
Sugar-dome chamber with the only exit in the centre of the ceiling, 6" from any wall.
Pop-rock vent that crackles and shrieks. Each Turn spent here or in adjacent rooms gives a Frightened Condition.
Tunnel caved in with crumbs, leaving a gap too small to crawl through.
Wide pool of half-set caramel blocking the way. Gives an Exhausted Condition per 6" traveled.
trap: Gingerbread slab chiselled loose from its frame. A device behind it tips it forward when the handle is turned.
Hallway flooded with fizzy soda, electrified by a Baker's battery in an alcove.
Dark room thick with floating sugar dust. Sweet, choking smell. d20 damage if ignited.
Thin licorice string stretched across a deadly drop. Safe if traveling slowly, one at a time.
Pit blocking the way. A jam-drake is asleep at the bottom.
Door with three gumdrop handles: one safe, two coated in sour poison. Poison handles deal d12 damage.
Ring of sprinkle-fairy toadstools with a young candyfolk inside. Those within try desperately to get others to enter.
Floor covered in fresh, warm taffy. Requires a STR save to pull a foot loose.
puzzle: Floor made of a hot griddle plate. A piece of valuable treasure sits in the centre.
Three syrup bottles of different colours. Each is inert alone but powerful or dangerous when mixed.
A block of hard candy with a magic sword embedded inside. It is very hard, but dissolves slowly in warm water.
Treasure is at the bottom of a deep syrup well.
Large steel mixing bowl, upside down. Treasure is taped to the inside of the bowl.
Baited mousetrap. The lever is wired to a wafer support beam and will collapse the corridor if triggered.

spells: Fireball
Shoot a fireball up to 24". Deal [SUM] + [DICE] damage to all creatures within 6".
Bake in the heart of a Baker's oven for three days and nights.
Heal
Heal [SUM] STR damage and remove the Injured Condition from a creature.
Break off a crumb of yourself for d6 STR damage, sprinkle it on the spell.
Magic Missile
Deal [SUM] + [DICE] damage to a creature within sight.
Drop from the top of a rock-candy peak. Touch the spell within one Turn.
Fear
Give the Frightened Condition to [DICE] creatures.
Receive the Frightened Condition from a hostile creature while carrying the spell.
Darkness
Create a [SUM] x 2" diameter sphere of pure darkness for [DICE] Turns.
Leave inside a closed chocolate box for three days.
Restore
Remove Exhausted or Frightened Condition from [DICE] + 1 creatures.
Bury in a peaceful lollipop meadow for three days.
Be Understood
Make your meaning clear to [DICE] creatures of another species for [DICE] Turns.
Give away freely to a creature of another species.
Ghost Gummy
Create an illusory gummy bear that can carry 6 inventory slots for [DICE] x 6 Turns.
Bury in a biscuit graveyard for three nights.
Light
Force [DICE] creatures to make a WIL save or become stunned. Alternately, create light as bright as a torch for [SUM] turns.
Catch in the first light of a sunrise and the last light of sunset for three days.
Invisible Ring
Creates [DICE] x 6" ring of force. It is invisible and immovable. Lasts [DICE] Turns.
Build a sugar-glass ring the same size as last cast. Pass the spell through it. Dissolves the ring.
Knock
Open a door or container, as if a Save were made with STR score of 10 + [DICE] x 4.
Put in a cookie tin, inside a cookie tin, inside a cookie tin. Leave for three days.
Syrup Slick
Cover [DICE] x 6" area in slippery, flammable syrup. Creatures in the area must make a DEX save or fall prone.
Soak in melted butter. Leave until it goes rancid.
Grow
Grow a creature to [DICE] + 1 times its original size for 1 Turn.
Leave on top of the tallest lollipop for three days.
Invisibility
Make creature invisible for [DICE] Turns. Any movement reduces duration by 1 Turn.
Go a day without opening your eyes once, while holding the spell.
Sour Lure
Turn object into an irresistible lure for sour barons. Lasts [DICE] Turns.
Give a sour baron a gift it truly desires.
